Related: #2783, #3097, #3310, #3647

## Steps to Reproduce

```
- X
  - A
  - B
  - C
  - D
  - E
- Y
```

1. Set the cursor to null. 
2. Set the cursor on `X`. 

## Current Behavior

`E` shifts down as it fades in. 

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e8cb3da5-da58-48b1-bbaf-98ef7579b0db

## Expected Behavior

`E` should only fade in, with no change in y position.
input.title: Last subthought shifts down on initial render
